samples.description: Shared annual COMP.FUNDA sample for Roychowdhury (2006) Table 4, fiscal 1987-2001, after domestic industrial standard-format filters, SIC exclusions, source-supported availability and complete abnormal outcomes/controls. Each annual PRCC_F price currency is verified against its historical issue and same-issue/date security price evidence, with dated primary markers used as corroboration or explicit contradiction evidence; final counts are in review.md.

assumptions: Use OLS within each annual cross-section and the Fama-MacBeth time-series mean; the paper does not identify the annual cross-sectional estimator.
Use Newey-West lag 1 for annual coefficient series; the paper reports Newey-West but does not state the bandwidth.
Estimate Equation (1) within two-digit SIC/fiscal-year groups with at least 15 complete observations; size, MTB, and net income are demeaned within current SIC-year groups.
Use OLS within each annual cross-section and the Fama-MacBeth time-series mean; the paper does not identify the annual cross-sectional estimator.
Use Newey-West lag 1 for annual coefficient series; the paper reports Newey-West but does not state the bandwidth.
Use lagged sales for the normal discretionary-expense Equation (5), following the equation and Appendix A despite the contemporaneous-sales term printed in the Table 2 note.
Set missing R&D and advertising to zero only when SG&A is available; estimate Equation (5) within SIC-year groups with at least 15 complete observations.
Use OLS within each annual cross-section and the Fama-MacBeth time-series mean; the paper does not identify the annual cross-sectional estimator.
Use Newey-West lag 1 for annual coefficient series; the paper reports Newey-West but does not state the bandwidth.
Construct production costs as COGS plus the change in inventory; estimate Equation (4) within SIC-year groups with at least 15 complete observations.

limitations: The current COMP.FUNDA construction yields 48,057 firm-years, 7,899 firms, and 44 industries, versus 21,758, 4,252, and 36 reported in the paper. There are 50,153 Appendix-complete rows before the 15-observation group cutoff and 529 qualifying industry-years versus 416 in the paper; no specific cause of the excess is confirmed, and historical cohort coverage is unverified.
Table 4 leaves the annual cross-sectional estimator and Newey-West bandwidth unspecified. The implementation uses annual OLS cross-sections and Newey-West lag 1 as documented best-effort choices.
Equation (5) and Appendix A use lagged sales for normal discretionary expenses, while the Table 2 note prints contemporaneous sales; the implementation follows Equation (5) and Appendix A.

The 1987 sample has 258 observations after industry-years with fewer than 15 observations are removed. Of 517 Appendix-complete rows, 258 lie in 8 qualifying industry-years; omitting the t-2 sales requirement adds 8 rows. A completeness diagnostic omitting CFO-related fields yields 3,258 rows, indicating that local data availability contributes to the low 1987 count.

An exact-key audit of the A2 lagged-price rows found 2,944 positive PRCC_F observations without either a same-date primary-IID CURCDD or same-month CURCDM code. Their price currency remains unknown, so corresponding size and market-to-book values are unavailable. The build uses daily fiscal-date EXRATD for annual PRCC_F, an explicit point-date choice that the provider guide permits alongside monthly EXRAT1M.
